window.why: intersection of the three books' own published series; a blend cannot be priced on a day one of the books does not exist

caliber.weights_are: share of the 8% volatility budget after each book is scaled to it

execution.etf: decide at close t, own from the open of t+1
execution.cb: signal at close t, filled at close t+1
execution.carry: close-to-close; gross of cost on the hedge leg

caliber.carry_is_gross: the hedged excess is gross of the hedge leg's cost; a real hedge also needs a second account (parent face's caliber, not re-estimated)

etf.arm: nobond_vt08 vol_target=8% n_hold=5 rebal=20 cost=10bp entry_lag=1
etf.execution: decide at close t, own from the open of t+1

cb.execution: signal at close t, filled at close t+1

raw.units: index points per lot per day

carry.arm: IC main contract, hedged excess (futures minus index), roll days zeroed
carry.execution: close-to-close; gross of cost on the hedge leg
carry.units: index points per lot per day (scale-free; every book is scaled to 8% vol before mixing)

three_book_rulers.why: etf and cb reproduce book_pair_blend.in_window bit for bit (0.957817 vs 0.9578173792, 0.540241 vs 0.5402413276); three_book_rulers prints the same books on its own annualisation clock, so its etf/cb rows differ from this face without either being wrong. carry is compared to the family's own hedged-excess arm, never to its basis-only row (3.189), which is a notional figure no wallet can hold.

book_pair_blend.why: that face mixes the parents at their own published volatility (convertible ~10 pct, ETF 8 pct); this one scales every book to 8 pct first, so the weights mean shares of the risk budget

same_risk_at_8pct.note: a scaled portfolio with leverage > 1 is the same bet with more money on it; the Sharpe does not change, the drawdown does

sentence: Three books, one wallet: the carry book has the best Sharpe of the three (1.445 vs 0.958 and 0.540) and still takes weight 0.00 in a 1,000,000 wallet, because one IC lot consumes 91029 CNY of the 8% volatility budget -- it fits only once the wallet is 5689312 CNY (w=0.20) 3413588 CNY (w=1/3). Inside the gate the best mix is ETF 65% / convertible 35% / carry 0%: 6.508% a year, Sharpe 1.060, drawdown -6.72%. Ignoring the gate the same grid would print Sharpe 1.844, so the gate costs 0.784 of Sharpe -- and that number is not a loss, it is a price nobody has paid yet.
